I recently had the challenge to do a shoe box cake. Once I had all the details figured out I went to work on it.

The Louboutin stencil on top was hand cut (to save money, instead of ordering one) and was then gently sponged on. Normally I would have made a totally edible lid but due to the horrible rain and what felt like 120% humidity, I went with foam core cardboard covered in fondant instead. This way I could avoid any collapsing issues with the supports underneath it to "prop" it up like the lid was slightly open.

The tissue paper look was created with edible wafter paper. The cake ended up measuring to be the size of an actual shoe box, was 3 layers of vanilla bean cake with matching vanilla bean buttercream.

Almost forgot about the board!!! The board was custom cut to size foam core, covered in fondant (I find that gives it a cleaner look and is a little something extra presentation wise), I then used some of my tools to give a "wood panel" look and then painted on the color with a mix of edible food color and everclear.
